target: Synthetic municipal daily demand (MGD) from climate/calendar process
target_definition: Synthetic daily municipal demand label produced by the generator in ai/water_demand_model.py — not AMI meters.
code_version_note: Trained via ai/water_demand_model.py; regenerate with py ai/train.py
split_strategy: random_iid_synthetic (70/15/15 with fixed seed). Chronological splits apply once real AMI time series replace synthetic labels.

evaluation_period.note: Synthetic rows; no real calendar evaluation period.

mean_baseline.note: R² of the mean predictor is 0 by definition. High model R² here measures recovery of the synthetic generator, not real utility accuracy.

seasonal_naive.reason: Synthetic rows are not a real multi-year demand series.

notes: SYNTHETIC LABELS — not AMI meters, not CWC reservoir releases.
Accepted only if validation and test R² ≥ 0.8.
Population and industrial index still scale the climate prediction at inference.
Use for UI/demo demand scenarios; replace with metered data for operations.
Performance measures recovery of the synthetic generator, not real-world validation.
limitations: SYNTHETIC LABELS — evaluation is synthetic-label validation only.
Random i.i.d. split is appropriate for synthetic rows; do not claim temporal generalization.
Population and industrial index scale the climate prediction at inference.
Replace with metered AMI/SCADA demand before operational forecasting.
